summary: Razzia is a quiz game platform intended as an open-source alternative to proprietary classroom tools like Kahoot! It allows you to host interactive trivia and quiz sessions for small gatherings on your own hardware.
goodFor: It suits small, self-hosted events or community meetups where you want a local quiz platform without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: With a modest maintenance profile and heavy competition from established proprietary alternatives, you may encounter edge cases or a lack of advanced features.
deployNotes: Provided as a Docker image built with Node.js, it typically requires a persistent volume for state storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
